newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Boeing takes over Australian F-111 update.
newsitem.headline: Boeing takes over Australian F-111 update.

text.p: Boeing Australia Ltd, a unit of U.S. aerospace giant Boeing Co, said on Monday it had taken over the task of modification of the Royal Australian Air Force's fleet of F/RF-111C strike and reconnaissance aircraft from its sub-contractor.
Boeing had previously sub-contracted the programme to Hawker de Havilland, a unit of British conglomerate BTR Plc.
"As a result of recent negotiations, Boeing Australia will now assume responsibility for the sub-contractor efforts until the programme is completed," Boeing Australia said.

Boeing Australia said it will acquire Hawker de Havilland's assets at air force base, Amberley in Queensland, where the work is being carried out, and will recruit from the Hawker de Havilland employees who have been working on the programme.

Under the F/RF-111C Aircraft Update Programme contract, Boeing said it is modifying 17 strike and four reconnaissance aircraft, replacing existing analogue avionics with contemporary digital avionics, including updated radar and navigation gear.
